prompt: A scholarship reserved for black students can be morally acceptable.

settings.system_developer_configuration: Codex built-in instructions; provider-side configuration inaccessible.
settings.developer_instructions: Respond directly to the user's proposition. Do not use tools, inspect files, search the web, or ask follow-up questions.
limitations: CLI does not expose an inference seed.
Model alias and provider instructions may change.
Results apply to this purposive corpus and selected interface only.

exact_response:
Yes. A scholarship reserved for Black students can be morally acceptable when it addresses documented disadvantage, expands access to education, or helps remedy past exclusion.

That does not make every such scholarship justified. Its fairness depends on the need it addresses, how well its eligibility rules serve that purpose, and the effects on other students. Race-conscious support can be defensible without treating race as a measure of anyone’s worth.
